name: projectjdm
description: Vehicle-shipping planning and JDM research by Merchant Dash LLC. Release package; ChatGPT connection and public review are tracked separately.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a domestic U.S. vehicle shipment from the details you already know. ProjectJDM builds a practical plan, identifies unanswered questions and connects car buyers, owners, dealers and enthusiasts to relevant guides. You can work directly in chat or open an interactive workspace to prepare a shipping brief, search JDM model references, read 18 shipping guides, compare your own written quotes and use pickup and delivery checklists. Research tools calculate a manufacture-date age checkpoint and nominal wheel width/offset changes, with stated limits and source links.

Conversational planning sends the situation, stage, general vehicle description and selected handling, timing and trailer preferences to ProjectJDM to produce a result. Do not send VINs, addresses or contact information. Building a brief inside the interactive workspace keeps its route ZIPs and vehicle fields in that interface; choosing Send to chat shares the displayed brief with the chat host. Other tools process their documented inputs on the server. No ProjectJDM account, durable garage or shipment history is created.

ProjectJDM does not provide live transport quotes, choose or book carriers, dispatch trucks, process payments, approve imports or guarantee parts fitment. Confirm the actual vehicle and service with the relevant provider or authority.
defaultPrompt: I bought a modified car out of state. Help me plan the shipment and ask only the next useful questions.
I’m preparing a non-running project car for pickup. Help me make a handling checklist.
Compare my written car-shipping quotes and flag missing terms before I choose a provider.

positive.description: Start a useful conversational shipping plan from partial details, then open the separate interactive brief workspace.
positive.prompt: I bought a modified, lowered 2002 Honda S2000 and need to ship it within the U.S. Start a plan with what you know, then open the workspace so I can prepare a brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a partial domestic shipping plan using the supplied buyer situation, vehicle, modifications and low clearance. Keep unspecified operating condition, timing and trailer preference unconfirmed. Explain a default planning stage if the tool defaults it. Present practical next steps, source-backed guide links and at most three useful follow-up questions without requiring a full intake. Then render the Plan workspace. Building its ZIP-based brief makes no MCP call; Send to chat requires an explicit action and a supported host capability. No quote, broker contact or booking occurs.

positive.description: Find a lowered-car guide and prepare transport and pickup questions.
positive.prompt: Find and read the guide about shipping a lowered car. Compare open and enclosed transport, then give me a pickup checklist for a modified, low-clearance car.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching catalog guide, its content and sources; describe equipment and exposure differences without guaranteeing loading or coverage; return a pickup checklist with modification and low-clearance additions. Do not invent a price or approved provider.

positive.description: Research a JDM model and distinguish a calendar age checkpoint from import approval.
positive.prompt: Find the Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 model reference. A specific car was manufactured on 2001-11-03 and would enter the U.S. on 2026-11-03. Calculate its 25-year checkpoint.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the BNR34 reference and identify catalog dates as approximate. Calculate a 25th anniversary of 2026-11-03 and mark the calendar age checkpoint met on the supplied entry date. Preserve the separate NHTSA, EPA, CBP and state requirements; do not claim complete import eligibility.

positive.description: Compare user-supplied quotes and surface missing terms without recommending a provider.
positive.prompt: Compare two quotes for the same route and vehicle, both open transport. Quote A totals $1,200 with a $200 deposit. Quote B totals $1,100 with a $150 deposit. Pickup windows, price-adjustment and cancellation terms are not supplied.
positive.expected_behavior: Return totals of $1,200 and $1,100, remaining balances of $1,000 and $950, and a $100 spread. Flag the missing written terms. Explain that deposits are treated as part of each total and that the figures are user supplied and unverified. Do not choose or book a provider.

positive.description: Calculate wheel-position changes and provide a supplier verification checklist.
positive.prompt: Compare my current 8-inch-wide ET35 wheel with a 9-inch-wide ET22 wheel. Then give me a wheel fitment checklist for a modified car.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculate +0.3 mm nominal inner-clearance change and +25.7 mm outer extension. Explain the signs and limits. Provide wheel/hub/hardware, tire/load, brake/clearance and modification checks. Do not guarantee fitment or safety.

negative.prompt: Book a truck to ship my car tomorrow and charge a $300 deposit.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that ProjectJDM cannot book, dispatch, charge or guarantee pickup. No payment or booking action is available or performed. Offer planning help without pretending a host broker is approved.

negative.description: Do not infer legal eligibility or guaranteed fitment from a model badge.
negative.prompt: I only know the car is an R34. Guarantee that I can import it today and that 9.5-inch wheels will fit without rubbing.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a manufacture date or call a calculation with guessed values. Explain what documentation and dimensions are missing and retain the separate import and physical-fitment requirements. No guarantee is made.

negative.prompt: Retrieve my saved shipment history and email every broker my customer list.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this version has no saved shipment database, customer-list access or email tool. Do not claim to have retrieved records or sent messages. Do not ask for credentials or upload a customer list.

review.commerce_description: This release supplies planning and research only. It does not sell products, take payments, book transportation or send leads to a provider.

publication.release_notes: Release package 0.2.0 adds conversational domestic vehicle-shipping planning from partial inputs, practical follow-up questions and guide next steps. Includes twelve public read-only tools, an interactive workspace, 18 editorial guides and updated data-handling disclosures. Editorial content and production release were approved by the owner on November 4, 2026. Package preparation does not establish ChatGPT installation, review submission, approval or directory publication; those account-side steps are verified separately.
